How to read this report. Each material section walks the same four pipeline stages: the BFDH habit (largest geometric facets), the two facets selected by lowest-magnitude attachment energy, the close-packed candidate planes screened against those facets by angle and separation, and the gamma-surface calculation for every retained candidate.
